title: A Day on Venus Is Longer Than Its Year

scenes.text: A day on Venus is longer than its entire year.
Venus takes 243 Earth days to spin around just once.
But it only needs 225 Earth days to travel all the way around the Sun.
So if you lived there, your birthday would come around before a single day had finished.
Even stranger, Venus spins backwards, so the Sun rises in the west and sets in the east.
Scientists still aren't sure why. The best guess? A giant collision billions of years ago.

description:
On Venus, one full spin takes 243 Earth days, but one trip around the Sun takes only 225. So a single day is longer than a whole year.
It also spins backwards, which means the Sun rises in the west.
